declarations.rationale: Full literal role inspection separates three opposing-team play rows from two coach-to-player play rows. The latter plus three coach removal rows form a narrow sporting-selection family; removal alone is not sufficient to grade fielding as supported. Independently reviewed by Boyle; unrelated candidate/office roles excluded.

Three explicit lobbyist paths form the largest specific coherent role family. Two director-of-legislation paths are competing nearby roles; the apparent third director path has a different attachment. Independently reviewed by Boyle; weak mixed-title signal retained without broad affiliation.
